title: 88Vape Any Tank Fruit Salad 10ml E-Liquid
description: Rainbow Burst from 88Vape is a rush of sweet candy flavour from your first vape to your last. A kaleidoscope of juicy, chewy, sugary sweet candy flavours, Rainbow Burst is an essential flavour for any vaper with a sweet tooth. This e-liquid from 88Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing delicious flavour, smooth throat yet tactile throat hit and satisfying clouds. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at budget-friendly prices. Their 50/50 e-liquids are suitable for most kinds of vape devices, so users can enjoy their favourite flavours with the minimum of fuss.
